artifacts.name: By condition

words: Compares condition: treated against control (the reference), 8 samples in all.
The replicate unit is the subject: 4 subjects in control, 4 subjects in treated.
The model: Intercept + condition[T.treated]; 2 coefficients over 8 rows (subjects in conditions), 6 degrees of freedom left for the variation between subjects.
treated − control: from 4 subjects in treated and 4 subjects in control.
